question: My Murder targets Player 2's Grizzly Bears and I control Kalitas. When Murder resolves, does Player 2's Blood Artist trigger, and can Player 2 respond before my Zombie arrives?

expected.shortAnswer: No to both: Kalitas exiles the Bears instead, so nothing dies, and the Zombie is part of that replacement.
expected.answer: No to both. Kalitas's ability is a replacement effect (614.1a): as Murder resolves, Player 2's Grizzly Bears is exiled instead of going to the graveyard, so it never dies (700.4) and Blood Artist has nothing to trigger on. The Zombie is created as part of the same modified event (614.6); it doesn't use the stack, so Player 2 gets no chance to respond between the exile and the Zombie. Player 2 can still respond to Murder now, while it is on the stack.

whyHard: A replacement effect changes the event itself, so nothing dies and nothing triggers, and the replacement's own result never uses the stack.
